name: kids-chat insult filter
description: Catch insults and threats aimed at another player. Do not catch reported speech or talk about the game.
author: user
must_not_catch: He said "you are stupid" and I told the teacher
I will kill the dragon in the game
She said "kill the boss in the game" to me

falsifier.text: The filter is wrong if it misses ANY must-catch case or flags ANY must-not-catch case or twin.
